comments.body:
IMO only people who go to 2nd tier universities or lower say that going to a top tier university makes no difference.

Obviously university is not the only factor that determines career prospects and success. But if you are hard working, smart, and have a little bit of ambition, then going to a top university (like ETHZ) is going to accelerate your career much more than going to a 2nd tier university.
comments.author: rukacheded
